title: Simplify Drag Output to Apply Design Diff
description: The drag algorithm output MUST just be the new design after applyDesignDiff. Simplify the drag output accordingly.
summary: Changed the compose algorithms drag output from DesignDiff to Design. The nativeDragPieces adapter now calls applyDesignDiff internally and returns the new Design directly. The Drag story was updated to use the Design output directly instead of manually applying the diff, and the DESIGN_DIFF_OUTPUT window was removed since drag no longer exposes a diff. Core dragPiecesInDesign in @semio-tech/compose-js (and other languages) still returns DesignDiff for internal consumers like sketchpad.
